programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Building of Britain
programme.desc: Turning his attentions to timber structures from the Middle Ages the former steeplejack visits England's oldest fortified building with a moat, Stokesay Castle. He also journeys to Harvington Hall near Kidderminster, Worcestershire, to see how bricks became an important part of timber-framed houses

programme.title: Villages by the Sea
programme.desc: Archaeologist Ben Robinson unearths the ancient past of Greyabbey, a small village on Northern Ireland's beautiful Strangford Lough. This is a story of life from the sea - of the money-making kelp industry, and ingenious methods of catching fish

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Building of Britain
programme.desc: Fred Dibnah demonstrates the engineering and design skills that shaped Scottish baronial style. He visits Glamis Castle to show how the sandstone tower was transformed by Italian plasterers to resemble a fairy-tale castle, and the House of Dun near Montrose, designed by William Adam

programme.title: Villages by the Sea
programme.desc: Archaeologist Ben Robinson travels to Johnshaven, a once important Scottish fishing village. When its skilled sailors were pressganged into the Royal Navy in the late 18th century, it had to diversify into the flax and jute trade - which fed into the jute capital, the nearby city of Dundee. Ben discovers the ruins of an old cloth mill used to make cloth for sails and later coarse linen sacking, a product vital for transporting goods and tries to solve the village mystery of what a circular building in a local's garden could have been

programme.title: The Hunt for Lady Olive and the German Submarine
programme.desc: On the morning of February 19, 1917, German U-boat UC-18 opened fire on Royal Navy Q-ship the Lady Olive, but as the submarine drew near to assess the damage it had inflicted, the Lady Olive counter-attacked. Both vessels were said to have sunk. For decades, divers and historians have searched to discover their fate and understand the story that led to this encounter. This documentary follows film-maker Karl Taylor and his specialist team over four years as they search to uncover what happened on that fateful day in 1917

programme.title: Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid (1969)
programme.desc: Two notorious outlaws' routine of bank and train robberies is cut short when a seemingly unstoppable posse is formed to catch them. The pair plan to flee America and start a new life in Bolivia, with the Sundance Kid's schoolmistress lover in tow - but staying ahead of the law is not so easy. Western, starring Paul Newman, Robert Redford and Katharine Ross

programme.title: Talking Pictures
programme.desc: An insight into the life of the Hollywood actor, who is one of the screen's greatest heart-throbs, featuring rarely seen interviews that reveal he was much more than just a pin-up. Narrated by Sylvia Syms

programme.title: The Mirror Crack'd (1980)
programme.desc: Miss Marple investigates a murder on a film set starring feuding Hollywood stars Marina Rudd and Lola Brewster. When a local woman dies after drinking a poisoned cocktail made for Marina, everyone assumes the actress was the intended victim because she had received death threats. However, the sleuthing spinster is not convinced. Agatha Christie mystery, with Angela Lansbury, Elizabeth Taylor, Kim Novak and Rock Hudson

programme.title: Arena
programme.sub-title: Peggy Sue: Tales of Rock and Roll
programme.desc: An interview with the woman who inspired one of Buddy Holly's most famous songs. Arena takes Peggy Sue Gerron Rackham back to Lubbock in Texas. This is where she went to the same high school as Holly and where her marriage to his drummer Jerry Allison inspired a second tribute, Peggy Sue Got Married. She reveals how both songs came to be written and provides insight into the singer's short career

programme.title: It's Only Rock 'n' Roll: Rock 'n' Roll at the BBC
programme.desc: A compilation of classic rock 'n' roll artists and songs in celebration of the musical genre. Including performances by Jerry Lee Lewis, Dion, Dick Dale and Neil Sedaka, who all featured in the Rock 'n' Roll America series. Plus, a selection of songs with rock 'n' roll in the title, such as Tom Petty's Anything That's Rock 'n' Roll, Joan Jett's I love Rock 'n' Roll and Oasis's Rock 'n' Roll Star

programme.title: Elizabeth Taylor: A Tribute
programme.desc: A programme dedicated to the Oscar-winning actress, with friends, family and co-stars sharing their memories and looking back on her career, as well as her humanitarian work and much-publicised personal life. Featuring contributions from Liza Minnelli, Joan Collins, Pierce Brosnan, Angela Lansbury, David Frost, Larry King, Robert Hardy, Barry Norman and Richard Burton's nephew Guy Masterson

programme.title: BBC Proms
programme.desc: Three 2016 BBC Young Musician finalists - Jess Gillam, Ben Goldscheider and Sheku Kanneh-Mason - perform former BBC Radio 3 New Generation Artist Gwilym Simcock's Triple Concerto. Britten's The Young Person's Guide to the Orchestra and Dvorák's 'New World' Symphony complete a the programme. Georgia Mann presents. Britten: The Young Person's Guide to the Orchestra 18'. Gwilym Simcock: Triple Concerto for Soprano Saxophone, Horn and Cello 20' BBC co-commission (world premiere). Interval. Dvorák Symphony No 9 in E minor, 'From the New World' 40'. Jess Gillam (saxophone), Ben Goldscheider (horn), Sheku Kanneh-Mason (cello), BBC Symphony Orchestra, conductor Sakari Oramo

programme.title: Country House Auction

Gloster house owners and self-confessed auction addicts Tom and Mary are on the hunt for some antique gems for their 300-year-old home, while cabinetmaker Kieran restores a classic Victorian Cheval mirror for the sale

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: In Uttoxeter, east Staffordshire, Shail and Cecilia long for a garden that reminds them of growing up in the countryside of India. However, the new-build garden they own is a featureless sloping plot. Lee Burkhill and Flo Headlam pool their efforts to create an entertainment space in the middle of the garden with a central patio featuring bespoke screesn and L-shaped benches. Lee adds a home-made tandoor for the family to cook together and a food prep area and vegetable growing beds. Flo mucks in with a planting area to draw attention from the giant walls and herb garden by the back door

programme.title: Women Behind Bars with Trevor McDonald
programme.desc: Part one of two. The veteran broadcaster follows life inside two prisons holding some of America's most notorious female criminals - Indiana Women's Prison and Rockville Correctional Facility in the same US state. Among the inmates he meets in the first edition are Sarah Pender, who went on the run while serving 110 years for double murder, before being captured four months later, and Martha Search, who is looking forward to getting to grips with modern technology when her 20-year sentence comes to an end

programme.title: Women Behind Bars with Trevor McDonald
programme.desc: Part two of two. The veteran broadcaster meets more inmates inside two of Indiana's most dangerous women's prisons. Among them are Dawn Hopkins, who was sentenced to life for murdering her three-month-old son, and Sarah 'Cindy' White, who was incarcerated as a teenager and will spend the rest of her life behind bars. The journalist also hears the remarkable story of Linda Darby who, after escaping from jail in 1972, spent the next 35 years on the run - before the law finally caught up with her

programme.title: DIY SOS
programme.desc: Nick Knowles meets Scunthorpe woman Caroline Blanchard, a single mum who has twice had to make the decision to turn off the life support for people she loves. The boys, still grieving for their mum's untimely death, are forced to share a single bedroom with a triple bunkbed. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot
